panel.features: backtest-safe (2020 poll only; no overrides, Wikipedia or Kanto tilt)

signals.model_legacy: Model residual (live-site features: overrides, Wikipedia, Kanto)
signals.cheap_in_cluster: Cheapest in its rarity group (log price vs group mean)

fresh_release.note: cards <=35d old. About a dozen set releases drive this, so the weekly t-stat overstates confidence; see the per-release table

gate_check_oos.note: Model IC after OOS_START with and without the live site's leaderboard gates (dead zone + chase premium), which were tuned on the in-sample history.

live.note: The calls the site actually published (live-site features), graded against later daily prices. Few, overlapping weeks: indicative only.

caveats: Trades buy 7 days after the signal. Buying on the signal date lets price noise pose as edge (see the bridge table: skip 0 vs 7).
In-sample means the history the model, gates and features were tuned on (to 2026-06-11). Out-of-sample is later, from the site's own daily prices, and is only a few overlapping months.

Out-of-sample prices come from a different feed (pokemontcg.io / TCGdex vs tcgcsv); both report TCGplayer market price and agree within ~15% on about 93% of cards at the splice. Momentum lookbacks in the first weeks after the splice mix the two.
Fresh-release results rest on about a dozen set releases; weekly cuts inside one release are not independent.
Significance uses Newey-West (HAC) t-stats for the overlapping windows.
Universe is products that still exist on TCGplayer today (mild survivorship), and the historical price variant was picked from today's card data.
